title: Asymptotic stability of Benjamin--Ono multisolitons in $L^2(\mathbb R)$
summary: We prove the following dichotomy result for $L^2(\mathbb R)$ solutions to the Benjamin--Ono equation: On windows traveling at any speed, the solution either converges to zero or to a soliton dictated by the spectral properties of the Lax operator associated to the initial data. As an application of this result, we prove asymptotic stability of Benjamin--Ono multisolitons in $L^2(\mathbb R)$.
